headline: X replaces its revenue-sharing program with ‘Original Content Rewards’
summary: X is ending its creator revenue-sharing program. A new 'Original Content Rewards' program launches September 8th. Creators need 500+ verified followers and 500K+ impressions to qualify.

headline: An Amazon data center could have the worst polluting power plant in the country
summary: Amazon is funding a new West Texas power plant for its data center. This gas-burning plant could be a top US greenhouse gas producer. The investment raises significant environmental pollution concerns.

headline: Buc-ee’s dodges John Oliver to sue another small business
summary: Buc-ee's, known for suing small businesses, was dared by John Oliver to sue him. Oliver created merchandise featuring his own mascot with Buc-ee's-like branding. The company instead sued another small gas station, avoiding Oliver's challenge.

headline: Musician and entrepreneur Tom Vek is building a digital music player, but don’t call it retro
summary: Musician Tom Vek is venturing into hardware, developing a new digital music player. He emphasizes it's not a retro device, aiming for innovation. Vek is known for his unique indietronica sound and entrepreneurial spirit.

headline: Mortal Kombat Director 'Not Sure' About Return for Third Movie as Mortal Kombat 3 Remains in Limbo
summary: Mortal Kombat movie director Simon McQuoid is unsure about returning for a third film. The fate of 'Mortal Kombat 3' is currently in limbo. His potential absence casts a shadow on the franchise's cinematic future.

headline: Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Opening Permanent Location Featuring Animatronic Stage Shows in 2027
summary: Freddy Fazbear's Pizza is getting a permanent real-life location. It will feature animatronic stage shows, replicating the game's setting. The attraction is scheduled to open in 2027, bringing Five Nights at Freddy's to life.

headline: 'They Fundamentally Don't Understand Art' — Doom Dev Blasts Xbox After Microsoft 'Gutted' id Software With Layoffs
summary: A Doom developer lashed out at Xbox following layoffs at id Software. Lead programmer Chris Hays stated Xbox 'fundamentally don't understand art'. The criticism comes after Microsoft's recent job cuts 'gutted' the studio.

headline: The Best Deals Today: AirPods Pro 3, LEGO Back to the Future, Saros, and More
summary: Discover today's top deals on popular tech and entertainment items. Find discounts on products like AirPods Pro 3 and LEGO Back to the Future sets. The article provides a guide to current consumer savings.

headline: Andy Burnham to embark on cost of living tour through the UK
summary: Andy Burnham is set to launch a UK tour addressing the cost of living crisis. No 10 claims the Prime Minister's plans will alleviate financial strain. Opposition figures, however, accuse the government of 'hypocrisy'.

headline: Fifa criticises campaign to oust president Infantino
summary: FIFA has strongly criticized an ongoing campaign to oust its president, Gianni Infantino. The organization views these efforts as an attempt to 'undermine' its authority. FIFA remains defiant against challenges to its leadership.

headline: Killed a month after his wedding - why PC Andrew Harper's death touched so many
summary: PC Andrew Harper's death, just a month after his wedding, resonated deeply with the public. The case has returned to the spotlight following the early release of two killers. This decision has renewed public anger and sorrow.

headline: Israel accused of weaponising archaeology at ancient West Bank sites
summary: Israel faces accusations of weaponizing archaeology in ancient West Bank sites. The country plans large-scale land expropriations in historic Palestinian areas. Critics argue this strategy aims to strengthen Israeli control over the region.
